headline: Duchamp Gave Up Art for Chess. At MoMA, He Inspires a New Gambit.
context: Susan Polgar, a chess grandmaster, will be playing 50 artists, critics and fans of Marcel Duchamp at the same time, in honor of his birthday, July 28.
